titleEn: Count Ways To Build Good Strings
title: 统计构造好字符串的方案数
summary: 每次向字符串追加 zero 个零或 one 个一，统计最终长度位于 [low,high] 的不同构造方案数，结果取模。
insight: 只关心当前长度。dp[length] 表示到达该长度的追加序列数，从每个长度分别向 length+zero 与 length+one 转移。
pitfalls: zero 与 one 相等时两种追加仍是不同选择
只累加目标区间内长度

solutions.title: 按长度动态规划
solutions.idea: 把追加零块和一块视为两条有向转移。
steps: 若 length+zero 不超过 high 则累加 dp[length]，one 同理
返回 dp[low..high] 之和并取模

code.java: class Solution { public int countGoodStrings(int low,int high,int zero,int one){int mod=1_000_000_007;long[] dp=new long[high+1];dp[0]=1;for(int length=0;length<=high;length++){if(length+zero<=high)dp[length+zero]=(dp[length+zero]+dp[length])%mod;if(length+one<=high)dp[length+one]=(dp[length+one]+dp[length])%mod;}long answer=0;for(int length=low;length<=high;length++)answer=(answer+dp[length])%mod;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countGoodStrings(low:Int,high:Int,zero:Int,one:Int):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;val dp=LongArray(high+1);dp[0]=1;for(length in 0..high){if(length+zero<=high)dp[length+zero]=(dp[length+zero]+dp[length])%mod;if(length+one<=high)dp[length+one]=(dp[length+one]+dp[length])%mod};var answer=0L;for(length in low..high)answer=(answer+dp[length])%mod;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countGoodStrings(int low,int high,int zero,int one){const int mod=1'000'000'007;vector<int> dp(high+1);dp[0]=1;for(int length=0;length<=high;++length){if(length+zero<=high)dp[length+zero]=(dp[length+zero]+dp[length])%mod;if(length+one<=high)dp[length+one]=(dp[length+one]+dp[length])%mod;}int answer=0;for(int length=low;length<=high;++length)answer=(answer+dp[length])%mod;return answer;} };
